2.text: The gold-silver ratio tells you how many ounces of silver it takes to buy one ounce of gold.
In March 2020 it hit 124 to 1, one of the most extreme readings in recorded history.
Over the next 18 months it fell back toward 65 to 1 as silver outperformed gold sharply.
